# Comoros Administrative Divisions

> Open dataset of Comoros's administrative hierarchy:
> 3 islands, 17 prefectures, 55 communes.
> CC-BY-4.0 licensed.

## Quick Reference

- Total islands: 3
- Total prefectures: 17
- Total communes: 55
- Coordinates: included (all levels)
- Last updated: 2026-09-02
- License: CC-BY-4.0

## Aggregate Data Files

- [All islands (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/open-admin-data/comoros-administrative-divisions/main/data/all-island.json)
- [All prefectures (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/open-admin-data/comoros-administrative-divisions/main/data/all-prefecture.json)
- [All communes (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/open-admin-data/comoros-administrative-divisions/main/data/all-commune.json)
- [Flat array (NDJSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/open-admin-data/comoros-administrative-divisions/main/data/all-flat.ndjson)
- [Hierarchy tree (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/open-admin-data/comoros-administrative-divisions/main/data/hierarchy.json)
- [JSON Schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/open-admin-data/comoros-administrative-divisions/main/data/schema.json)

- [Anjouan (Ndzouani)](https://github.com/open-admin-data/comoros-administrative-divisions/tree/main/divisions/anjouan-ndzouani-km1/) — 5 prefectures, 20 communes
- [Grande Comore (Ngazidja)](https://github.com/open-admin-data/comoros-administrative-divisions/tree/main/divisions/grande-comore-ngazidja-km2/) — 9 prefectures, 29 communes
- [Mohéli (Mwali)](https://github.com/open-admin-data/comoros-administrative-divisions/tree/main/divisions/mohli-mwali-km3/) — 3 prefectures, 6 communes

## Schema Fields

- id: Unique identifier
- level: 1 (island), 2 (prefecture), 3 (commune)
- name: Local and English names with URL slug
- code: Government codes
- parent: Reference to parent division
- ancestors: Full chain to root
- children_count: Count of children per level
- zip_codes: Postal codes (where available)
- geo: Geographic coordinates (lat/lon, WGS84, all levels)
